headline: UK Establishes £2 Billion Energy Wealth Fund Backed by North Sea Revenue
summary: The United Kingdom has launched a £2 billion Energy Wealth Fund alongside approval for the Jackdaw gas field. The vehicle will channel North Sea oil and gas tax revenues into renewable investments, mimicking Norway's model.
why: Sovereign wealth funds redirect resource extraction revenues into long-term investments, altering national fiscal policies and energy transition funding.

impacts.name: UK Energy Sector
impacts.why: State channeling of fossil fuel revenues into renewables alters capital allocation across British energy firms.
